blocks male hormones, so it's used off-label for acne and female pattern hair loss
improves survival and cuts hospital stays in heart failure (approved use)
lowers blood pressure as an add-on drug (approved use)
acne improved slightly more than on placebo in women; 82% versus 63% saw better skin
about 81% with female pattern hair loss improved (off-label; mostly uncontrolled studies)
